name: WordPress Content Health Monitor with Smart Alerts

parameters.content:
## WordPress Content Health Monitor

WordPress site owners, bloggers, and SEO professionals who want automated weekly content quality monitoring.

### How it works
1. Fetches your published posts via the WordPress REST API
2. Identifies stale content (not updated in 180+ days)
3. Finds thin content (posts under 300 words)
4. Detects posts missing images in the opening section
5. Calculates an overall content health percentage score
6. Sends a prioritized action report via Telegram or Slack

### Setup
1. Open the "Site Configuration" node and enter your WordPress site URL
2. Create an HTTP Basic Auth credential with your WordPress username and an Application Password (Users → Your Profile → Application Passwords). If your REST API is public, the workflow still works — the credential will simply pass through
3. Connect your preferred alert channel (Telegram bot or Slack webhook) — delete the one you don't use
4. Activate the workflow — it runs every Monday at 7 AM UTC

### Data Collection
Fetches up to 100 published posts from the WordPress REST API. Returns title, content, publication date, last modified date, and permalink for each post.

### Analysis Engine
Each post is scored on three health criteria:
- Freshness: flagged if not updated in 180+ days
- Depth: flagged if under 300 words
- Visual: flagged if no image in first 1000 characters

### Alert Channels
Choose one or both notification methods:
- Telegram: requires a bot token and chat ID
- Slack: requires an incoming webhook URL

Delete whichever channel you don't use.

### Customization
Edit thresholds in the "Analyze Content Health" node:
- STALE_DAYS: days before flagging (default: 180)
- MIN_WORDS: minimum word count (default: 300)

Edit max_posts in "Site Configuration" to scan more or fewer posts.
